sources.summary: Visual artist Christina Augustesen used acrylic lamellas to create a series of colourful sculptures, with hues that change depending on how the light hits them, for the 3 Days of Design festival in Copenhagen. The installation was a collaboration with Danish window manufacturer Velux, shown at Pas Normal Studio's exhibition space in Copenhagen's trendy Nordhavn The post Christina Augustesen creates "daylight sculptures" to evoke colours of sunset appeared first on Dezeen .
